title: Linear Regression
hint: Closed-form: augment X with ones column, solve w = (X^T X)^{-1} X^T y via torch.linalg.lstsq. Gradient descent: grad_w = (2/N) * X^T @ (pred - y), update w -= lr * grad_w. nn.Linear: create nn.Linear(D, 1), use MSELoss + optimizer.step() loop.

description.text: Implement linear regression y_hat = X @ w + b for X of shape (N, D) and y of shape (N,) using three methods: closed-form normal equations, manual gradient descent without autograd, and nn.Linear with an optimizer.

examples.input: N=100, D=3, synthetic X and y = X @ w_true + b_true + noise
examples.output: All three methods return (w, b) close to the true coefficients.
examples.explanation: Closed form is exact for noiseless full-rank data; GD and nn_linear converge with enough steps.

constraints: closed_form must not use iterative optimization.
gradient_descent must not use autograd for the manual loop.
nn_linear must use nn.Linear and autograd.
